problem: Every glyph is reflected: the font stores code 288 - ord(char). Extraction without decoding yields byte-shifted gibberish that still counts as a fat text layer.
evidence: The running head decodes as EXALTED THE OUTCASTE; chapter heads as CHAPTER ONE LOOKSHY AND THE SEVENTH LEGION and CHAPTER THREE THE FOREST WITCHES; printed folios decode to their own page numbers. The mapping is proved by the book, not inferred.
extractor: poppler (pdftotext), NOT pdfminer - pdfminer silently DROPS U+00AD, which is this cipher's lowercase 's' (288-115=173). Losing a letter silently is worse than any garble.

0x2d.why: U+00AD soft hyphen, which poppler renders as '-'; 288-115=173. A real hyphen encodes as 0xF3 and decodes normally, so every 0x2D here is an 's'.

0x4b.why: apostrophe (raw ASCII passthrough; a real letter K arrives as 0xD5)

0x4e.why: left double quote (a real N arrives as 0xD2)

0x4d.why: right double quote (a real M arrives as 0xD3)

0x4f.why: em dash (a real O arrives as 0xD1)
